name: 18701 · Wilkes Barre, PA
findings: ZIP 18701 (Wilkes Barre) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18701 (Wilkes Barre) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
